items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 4:25pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the mid-Atlantic, as various weak fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South 4 occasionally 5 in the west of the area, but Variable 3 or less in the East, becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters this evening. Settling North or Northwest 2 to 4 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, but smooth in places.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming mainly fair tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northeast 2 to 4, veering East or Northeast tomorrow evening, and increasing occasionally 5 in Liverpool Bay for a short time. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters Monday morning, settling Northerly later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Isolated rain at first, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate at first.
